title: Firmware Update
body_html:
Firmware Update

Firmware upgrade is divided into two parts: controller(motherboard) upgrade and HMI(panel) upgrade. Only when both the motherboard and the panel are successfully upgraded can the firmware upgrade be considered complete. 

The order of these two parts does not matter, but it should be noted that no matter which step is carried out first, the device must be restarted after a successful upgrade before proceeding to the next step, and the device should be restarted again after the next step is successfully completed.

 

Firmware Upgrade Guide

The following are different firmware upgrade instructions for users in various situations. Please select the corresponding instructions based on your own circumstances and follow the steps.

According to the classification of the OneLaser machine type:

  • Firmware Upgrade Guide (For X Series Users)
  • Firmware Upgrade Guide (For Hydra Series Users)

 

According to the classification of computer systems:

  • Firmware Upgrade Guide (For Mac-Only Users)
  • Firmware Upgrade Guide (For Win-Only Users)

 

Firmware Upgrade File

X Series 

For users of the X series products, due to the continuous updates and iterations of the X series devices, depending on the time of your purchase, you need to select the corresponding motherboard upgrade files. The specific selection method is as follows:

  • You can check the bar code label on the motherboard to determine whether it is new or old. The old motherboard number has "1G" and the new motherboard does not.

 

For an Older Mainboard

  • If you see “1G” on the label, it indicates that this is an older mainboard, and you should use the corresponding legacy firmware for the upgrade.
  • Old Controller(mainboard) Firmware Upgrade File: [Download Mainboard Firmware 1.0]   (The latest version of this file is currently named: RDC6442G-1G-LY-Mod5-V7.99.10.upd)
  • Old HMI(panel) Upgrade File: [Download Control Panel Firmware 1.0]  (The latest version of this file is currently named: RDC6445G-MOD5(01.09.02).rar)

 

For a New Mainboard

  • If “1G” is not present on the label, it indicates that this is a new mainboard, and you should use the corresponding new firmware for the upgrade.
  • New Controller(mainboard) Firmware Upgrade File: [Download Mainboard Firmware 2.0]  (The latest version of this file is currently named: RDC6442G-LY-Mod5-V7.16.02-20250107.upd)
  • New HMI(panel) Upgrade File: [Download Control Panel Firmware 2.0]  (The latest version of this file is currently named: RDC6445G-MOD5-128Mb-V01.09.02.rar)
